units.source_text: 这些火星子迸散到银河中，然后扩展开去，岛村觉得自己仿佛又被托起漂到银河中去。

en.t: The sparks scattered into the Milky Way and then spread outward, and Shimamura felt as though he himself were being lifted up again and set adrift into the Milky Way.

units.source_text: 黑烟冲上银河，相反地，银河倏然倾泻下来。

en.t: Black smoke surged up into the Milky Way, and in contrast the Milky Way suddenly seemed to pour down.

units.source_text: 喷射在屋顶以外的水柱，摇摇曳曳，变成了朦朦的水雾，也映着银河的亮光。

en.t: The jet of water spraying beyond the roof swayed and turned into a dim mist, and it too reflected the light of the Milky Way.
